notes: v1.1.98: Auto-unlocks the 'secure your account' lock from the stored email - picks the email code path, and when Facebook asks to set a new password it skips that step if it can, otherwise sets a strong one and saves it. Also shows WHY an account is restricted and roughly for how long (reads Facebook's own stated time when given; otherwise a per-kind length that escalates with repeats), instead of one flat message for every restriction.
